ORDINANCE XLII OF 2000
SPECIAL PROCEDURE FOR PAYMENT OF
SALES TAX RULES, 2000
ORDINANCE XLII OF 2000
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part II,
15th August, 2000]
S.R.O.558(I)/2000,dated 12-8-2000.---In
exercise of the powers conferred by section 71 of the Sales Tax Act, 1990, the
Federal Government is pleased to make the following rules, namely:---
1. Short title, application and
commencement.----(1)
These rules may be called the Special Procedure for Payment of Sales Tax Rules,
2000.
(2) These shall apply to the Trading
Corporation of Pakistan on purchase, supply or export of ginned cotton.
(3) These shall come into force at once.
2. Definitions---(1) In these rules, unless there is anything
repugnant in the subject or context--
(a) "Act" means the Sales Tax Act,
1990;
(b) "TCP" means Trading Corporation
of Pakistan;
(c) "ginning" means the manufacture
of ginned cotton;
(d) "ginning unit" means
manufacturing unit engaged in ginning; and
(e) "ginner" means a person who is
engaged in the manufacture and supply of ginned cotton.
(2) The words and expressions used, but not
defined, herein, shall have the same meaning as assigned to them in the Act.
3. Purchase of cotton.---The TCP shall purchase or receive
ginned cotton only from such persons as are registered under the Sales Tax Act,
1990, against prescribed tax invoices to be issued by such registered persons.
4. Payment of tax.----(1) The ginner shall deliver ginned
cotton through a delivery note or gate pass to the TCP. The delivery note or
the gate-pass shall be serially numbered and shall indicate the quantity of the
cotton sold in the name of the TCP alongwith registration number, builty number
and date and registration number of the vehicle on which ginned cotton is being
transported
(2) The TCP, after receipt of ginned cotton in
its premises, shall settle the terms, if any, about quantity, weight and value
of the ginned cotton with the ginner within ninety days of the date of dispatch
of the ginned cotton from the ginning unit, and the changes in the quantity,
weight or value shall be indicated on the reverse side of the copies of the
delivery note or gate pass issued by the ginning unit.
(3) The ginning unit shall then issue the
prescribed sales tax invoice for the quantity and value of the ginned cotton
agreed between the ginner and TCP and the tax invoice shall show the date on
which the terms regarding quantity, weight and value of ginned cotton are
settled.
(4) The TCP shall remit the amount of sales tax
payable on cotton purchased during the month, by the 15th day of the month
following the month to which the tax invoice relates, through a bank draft
drawn and crossed in the name of the respective Collector of Sales Tax.
(5) The TCP shall submit to the Collector of
Sales Tax concerned the details of cotton purchased during a month in the
format given below by 20th day of the following month.

(6) If TCP fails to remit sales tax payable on
cotton purchased during a month through bank draft in the name of the Collector
of Sales Tax by the 15th day of the month, following the month to which the tax
invoice relates, TCP shall be liable to pay additional tax alongwith the amount
of sales tax as prescribed under the Act besides penalty under section 33
thereof.
